verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is built as a self-hosted gateway that connects the assistant to messengers. Its docs cover every app the story names: WhatsApp is production-ready via WhatsApp Web, Telegram is production-ready for bot DMs and groups, Discord works as a bot in DMs and guild channels, Slack has rich-message support, and iMessage support is native. The GitHub tagline "your assistant… in your chats" frames messaging, not a bespoke web page, as the primary surface. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the messaging channels working in practice, and deeper first-party detail on the Slack channel beyond a listing and a rich-messages page.
